newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African economy still shedding jobs.
newsitem.headline: South African economy still shedding jobs.

text.p: The South African economy is continuing to shed jobs despite healthy growth of 3.1 percent recorded in 1996, the Reserve Bank said in its latest Quarterly Bulletin.

Total employment in the formal non-agricultural sectors of the economy declined by 1.4 percent in the the third quarter of 1996, after declines of 1.1 percent in the second quarter and 3.9 percent in the first, the central bank said.
It was "disquieting" that the number of employment opportunities created during an economic recovery was getting smaller with each successive recovery, it added.
Formal employment has increased only once during any calendar year since 1989 when it rose by 0.7 percent in 1995.
